findings.action: Enrollment schedule + final Delay on every path
findings.finding: The workflows are scheduled to re-check companies monthly, on day 5 at 00:00. But every path ends with a 45-day Delay after the task is created. HubSpot does not re-enroll a record that is still in the workflow. So a company enrolled on the 5th is still waiting in the Delay on the next 5th (about 30 days later) and is skipped. This means reviews would come every other month, not monthly.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): enrollmentSchedule = MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DAYS, daysOfMonth [5]; shouldReEnroll = true with no re-enrollment triggers; Delay actions 64800 minutes (45 days): Standalone 23/48/50/52/54/56/58/60, Improving 13/23/25/28/30/32/34/36, At Risk 50/58/82/84/86/88/90/92. INFERENCE: HubSpot only re-enrolls records that are not currently enrolled.
findings.why: Companies may get a performance review every two months while the workflow names say monthly.
findings.verify: After the 5 November run, open one company enrolled in October and check its workflow history for a second enrollment. Or confirm whether the 45-day Delay is meant to space reviews out.

findings.finding: Each "Marketing Performance Review" task is due 45 business days after creation, at 08:00. That is about 9 weeks, for a review the workflow names call monthly.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): due_time delta 45 DAYS, daysOfWeek Monday to Friday, timeOfDay 08:00, on every Create task action.
findings.why: The task won't show as overdue until well after the next month's review should have happened.
findings.verify: Confirm the intended due date (e.g. 45 calendar days, or end of the month).

findings.finding: Both SpareFoot paths (true and false) create the same task: same title, body, owner per Portfolio Manager, queue, associations and due date. So the SpareFoot branch doesn't change the result. The branch also has no default path, so a company with SpareFoot (Y/N) empty would get no task at all.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): action 2 STATIC_BRANCH on sparefoot__y_n_, branches true/false, no defaultBranch; one distinct task body per workflow across all 8 Create task actions. VERIFIED (records): all 93 companies that currently meet one of the three filters have SpareFoot set to true or false, so none are affected today.
findings.why: The branch makes the workflows twice as long without effect, and an empty SpareFoot value would quietly stop a review.
findings.verify: Confirm whether SpareFoot was meant to change the task (e.g. a SpareFoot subtask). If not, confirm what should happen when SpareFoot is empty.

findings.workflow: Standalone Marketing | Monthly Performance Reviews | Marketing Services (UPDATED)
findings.action: Branch on Portfolio Mgr, SpareFoot = false path (action 16)
findings.finding: In Standalone, the SpareFoot = false branch on Portfolio Manager (action 16) has no default path. If the Portfolio Manager is empty or is anyone other than Brock, Sarah, Mohammad or "Not Assigned", the company gets no task. Its SpareFoot = true twin (action 15) and both branches in At Risk and Improving send those companies to the "Not Assigned" task.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): Standalone action 15 defaultBranch -> action 51; action 16 defaultBranch = none. Improving actions 4/7 default -> 27/35; At Risk actions 15/16 default -> 51/59. VERIFIED (records): all 7 companies that currently meet the Standalone filter have SpareFoot = false and a Portfolio Manager of Sarah Schlosberg (6) or Brock Hegr (1), so none are affected today.
findings.why: A Standalone company whose Portfolio Manager is cleared or changed to someone new would stop getting reviews without anyone noticing.
findings.verify: Confirm whether action 16 should have the same default path (to action 59) as action 15.

findings.action: "Not Assigned" and default paths (Standalone 51/59, Improving 27/35, At Risk 51/59)
findings.finding: When the company's Marketing Portfolio Manager is "Not Assigned" (or empty, where a default path exists), the "Marketing Performance Review" task is created with no owner. It goes into the Marketing Services queue unassigned.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): these Create task actions have no owner_assignment; queue_id 13519272. VERIFIED (records): 12 of the 69 companies that currently meet the At Risk filter would take these paths (10 with Portfolio Manager "Not Assigned", 2 with it empty).
findings.why: Unowned tasks only get worked if someone picks them up from the queue.
findings.verify: Confirm that picking these up from the queue is the intended process, and who does it.

findings.workflow: Improving Monthly Performance Reviews | Marketing Services (UPDATED)
findings.finding: Improving only takes Enterprise, Tier 1 and Tier 2 - L1, while At Risk also takes Tier 2 - L2 and Tier 3. 15 Live, PPC-enrolled companies with Trend to Goal = Improving are in Tier 2 - L2 or Tier 3, so none of the three workflows creates a review for them.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): Improving customer_tier IS_ANY_OF Enterprise, TIER 2, TIER 1; At Risk adds Tier 2 - L2, TIER 3. VERIFIED (records): 15 companies, e.g. Crown Outdoor Storage 19578791467 (Tier 3), Raymond Clinton Mini Storage 38958261120 (Tier 2 - L2).
findings.why: If these tiers should get an Improving review, they currently get none.
findings.verify: Confirm the tiers that should get the Improving review.

findings.finding: Team rule "subtasks are not linked to the ticket" can't be checked yet. Subtasks aren't in the workflow API, and no task has been created in the Marketing Services queue since 2026-10-06. The main task is linked to the company and, by design, to the ticket: the action copies the company's "Marketing" ticket association. The task body says the subtasks cover Berat's items (Google Business Profile, SpareFoot, website content). Their owners and links aren't visible in the configuration.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): associations = ENROLLED_OBJECT (type 192, task to company) + COPY_ASSOCIATION from company-to-ticket label "Marketing" (USER_DEFINED 64) to task-to-ticket (type 230), on all 24 Create task actions. VERIFIED (records): 0 tasks in queue 13519272 since 2026-10-06.
findings.why: The team rule is that only main tasks are linked to the ticket.
findings.verify: Send a screenshot of one Create task action's subtask settings, or re-run the audit after the 5 November run, when the records will show the subtasks' associations.

findings.workflow: Standalone Marketing | Monthly Performance Reviews | Marketing Services (UPDATED)
findings.finding: The HubSpot description for Standalone says it is "for at-risk customers". It matches At Risk's description word for word. The trigger has no Trend to Goal filter: it enrolls Live, PPC-enrolled companies with Standalone Services = Marketing.
findings.evidence: VERIFIED (config): description field of 1892197644 vs its enrollmentCriteria.
findings.why: Documentation only. Anyone reading the description will misread who the workflow is for.
